content.text: MCP/PIP synovitis w ulnar drift: RA; DIP nodes: OA
Normal contour, full digits, smooth mvt
- Thickened flexor tendons or flex contractures of fingers: Dupuytren’s contracture
thenar atrophy: median n.; hypothenar atrophy: ulnar n.
swan-neck/boutonnière: RA; claw hand: ulnar n.
Snuffbox tender: scaphoid frx until proven otherwise
- Nodules/cysts: nodule: rheumatoid nodule/gouty tophus, cyst: ganglion
Distal radius & ulna on medial & lateral surfaces
Grooves of wrist joints on dorsum of wrist
- Tenderness: De Quervain’s or styloid frx
loss of extend: tendon rupture or radial n.
Thumb flex, extend, abd, add, & opposition
Median n.: opposition; ulnar n.: interossei n.; radial:extend
F/E: weak: median/ulnar           A/A: weak: ulnar n. (interossei)
Thumb flex, extend, abd, add, opposition
Tap over median n. of wrist
Median: thumb, index, middle, radial ring
- keep elbow low, hold for 30 sec
